user.title: Add a room
user.description: Each room gets its own Music Assistant player and its own light show. After setup, approve the new player in Music Assistant. It joins the '<speaker> - Light sync' players automatically.

data_description.area: The Home Assistant area this room's lights are in. The room's device is placed there.
data_description.name: Leave empty for '<Room> Lights'.
data_description.lights: Leave empty to use every ZHA color light in the room. A light group helper is expanded in its member order; that order is the bulb numbering used by the layout option.
data_description.host: The machine running Music Assistant. If Music Assistant runs as a Home Assistant App, the Home Assistant host's IP address works.
data_description.port: Music Assistant's Sendspin server listens on 8927.

reconfigure.title: Change room
reconfigure.description: Change the room, its name or its lights. The room keeps its Music Assistant player. Changing the lights clears the bulb layout and ZHA group options.

data.zha_group_id: ZHA group for unison color changes
data.end_delay: Restore the lights after this much silence
data.pause_adaptive_lighting: Pause Adaptive Lighting during a show

data_description.zha_group_id: Optional, recommended. A ZHA group containing exactly these bulbs. Whole-room changes (the drop's white flash) then take one multicast frame, which keeps drops on time.
data_description.rate_max: Frames per second for the whole house, shared by every room that is playing (the lowest value set in any room applies). 20 trades a little Zigbee responsiveness for livelier lights; the governor backs off automatically if the mesh gets congested.
data_description.group_min_interval: Multicast frames use the coordinator's small broadcast table. Keep this at 2 s or more.
data_description.pause_entities: Other automations, switches or input booleans to turn off during a show and back on afterwards, if they were on. The room's Adaptive Lighting switches are handled by the option above.
data_description.end_delay: Pausing, skipping and short gaps between tracks do not restore the lights unless the silence lasts longer than this.
data_description.fallback_player: Optional, recommended. The speaker the lights follow (e.g. the Music Assistant player). Party mode uses its volume (quiet = gentle lights), its track timing (outro in the last 20 seconds) and track changes. When it plays without the light player grouped, the lights run the ambient palette from its album art.
data_description.layout: Optional. One line per bulb, in bulb order: 'x, y' from 0 to 100 (0, 0 = top left of a floor plan). Party mode uses it for left/right and top/bottom splits, nearest-neighbor pairs, sweeps and waves. Empty = bulbs in a row.
data_description.match_rooms: When this room plays in the same Music Assistant group as other rooms with this on, they run one show together: same colors, rhythm, rate and section changes on the same beat, each mapped onto its own bulbs. Off: this room runs its own show even when grouped.
data_description.color_format: How colors are sent. Automatic sends each bulb its native format (Hue: CIE xy, Third Reality: hue/saturation, like its 'Native hue/saturation color' quirk switch). Nothing on the bulbs is switched, so there is nothing to put back. Force one format if Hue and Third Reality colors don't match side by side.
data_description.light_sync_speakers: This room joins the '<speaker> - Light sync' player of every speaker ticked here. Playing to that player runs the lights in all rooms that joined it. All ticked = also join speakers added later.
data_description.pause_adaptive_lighting: Turns off every Adaptive Lighting switch that controls this room's lights when a show starts, and turns each one back on (if it was on) when the show has ended. A switch shared with another room that is still playing stays off until that room's show ends too.

error.group_members: That ZHA group must contain exactly the configured bulbs, no more and no fewer. Extra members would be left in show colors.
error.group_missing: That ZHA group no longer exists.
error.layout_invalid: Enter one 'x, y' line per configured bulb (numbers 0-100).
